metrics.name: SSIM
metrics.anchor:
Metrics. For assessing visual quality, we used PSNR, SSIM, and FID [11]. To
measure lip-synchronization, well-known LMD [18] and LSE-C/D [29] were em-
ployed. LMD computes the distance between lip landmarks of GT and the gener-
ated video, while LSE-C/D evaluates correspondence between audio and visual
features. Lastly, for measuring emotion intensity flow, RMSE, PCC, and CCC
were employed. These three metrics respectively gauge frame-wise distance, lin-
ear correlation, and agreement of emotions. For details of the metrics, refer to
Appendix B.1. For fair evaluation, intensity regression was conducted by [15],
which was not utilized in training.

formly from [0.90, 0.99], and αij for other edges including observed self-loops are sampled uniformly from

[0.30, 0.50] avoids the cycle between N2 and N3 becoming nonstationary. Moreover, to ensure stationarity
and avoid explosive behavior, we verify the spectral radius of the integrated excitation matrix after generating
αij. To discretize the sequences for our method, we select the time bins of length 0.1 and consider 600 effec-
